author: cli
text:
Re-read after the payload census. The hardest/hardest_overall split is unchanged and still means what the comment says - hardest is source-only because consumers depend on it, hardest_overall excludes nothing.

What changed: THIS FUNCTION HELD THE TWO SILENT TRUNCATIONS. Both hot lists sliced at 5 and the knowledge entries sliced at 20, and none of the three reported a total - a reader saw five and could not tell whether the repo had five or 314. All three now go through payload.rank_bound_report, so the payload says 5 of 314 and 12 of 99.

Worth keeping in view: silent slicing is the failure this project names in its own guard message elsewhere, and it was sitting in the first tool anybody calls.

author: agent
text:
Re-read after adding most_depended_on. The hardest/hardest_overall split and its comment are unchanged and still exact - hardest stays source-only because consumers depend on it - and all three lists still go through payload.rank_bound_report.

NEW: most_depended_on. Top entities by call in-degree, capped at 5, each carrying callers / guessed / is_test.

WHY IT EXISTS. The same manual move found a real defect on three consecutive unfamiliar repos: index it, sort by call in-degree, read the top few. prometheus put a 3-line memChunk.len at 1,619 callers; scikit-learn put _EstimatorPrettyPrinter.format at 292; django put ListMixin.append at 573. Two were confidently wrong and one was an honest guess reported as fact. That move was a habit of whoever was driving; now it is in the first tool anybody calls.

WHY IT IS NOT A DETECTOR, and this is the part to preserve against a future "improvement". No threshold, no warning, no flag. A heuristic on a heuristic would need a number chosen to make the three known cases light up, and it would then cry wolf on the genuinely hot utilities sitting beside them - django's assertRaisesMessage has 1,935 callers and every one is real; sklearn's top five are all exactly resolved. This surface asserts nothing. It puts the count next to how the count was resolved and lets the reader judge. Same posture as dig returning candidates and never ranking them by "why". The test asserts the absence of a verdict, so adding one will fail.

IT EARNED ITS PLACE ON THE FIRST RUN. django's render_to_string shows 834 callers of which ALL 834 are guesses, and order_by 800 with 798 - two instances of the ListMixin.append shape that nobody had noticed, visible immediately because `guessed` rides beside `callers`.

LOW_CONFIDENCE is shared with the grounding block and the caller warning; three surfaces now ask what a guess is and there is one answer.

Fixture note: the ordering assertion was VACUOUS first. Edges are tallied in file order, so defining the busy entity first made the natural order already sorted and deleting the rank changed nothing. The fixture now defines the less-depended-on function first. Second time this exact shape of luck has been caught by falsification in this file - see the aa_test/zz_prod note on the briefing test.
